day: # Church of Sweden: Den svenska evangelieboken (2003).  Each day has an Old
# Testament reading, an Epistle, a Gospel and a psalm, in three series
# (årgångar, cycle I-III: the first series was read from Advent 2005); from
# Palm Sunday to Easter Day four series follow the four evangelists in turn
# (cycle MATTEUS, MARKUS, LUKAS, JOHANNES: Matthew from Advent 2003).  A
# fifth reading some days give is a second Gospel (or Epistle).
# Source: evangelieboken.se (with links to Bibel 2000 at bibeln.se), read
# October 2026; the book names are given in English for the Bible links.
# Psalm verses are numbered as Swedish Bibles number them (the heading
# counted), so the links open Svenska Folkbibeln 2015 by default.
# Bibeltekster for kirkeåret (2011): for every day a first reading, a second
# reading and a Gospel (the preaching text) in three series (tekstrekker
# cycle I-III; series I is read from Advent 2025), and a story text
# (fortellingstekst, kind story) shared by all three.  Good Friday's fourth
# series, John 18-19, is given as the alternative Gospel each year.  Source:
# the Norwegian Bible Society's "Kirkeårets tekster", bibel.no (Bibel 2011)
# read October 2026.  The 24th to 26th Sundays after Trinity read the texts
# of the 6th, 5th and 4th Sundays after the Epiphany.  Psalm and other verse
# numbers are the Norwegian Bible's (Hebrew numbering).  When the
# Annunciation (Maria budskapsdag) falls on the 4th Sunday in Lent, that
# Sunday's texts are read on the next (the calendar's 5th).
# Folkekirkens tekstrækker (Alterbog 1992): a first reading (Old Testament or
# psalm), an Epistle and a Gospel (the preaching text) in two series (første
# and anden tekstrække, cycle I-II; the second series is read from Advent
# bracketed optional verses are given in parentheses.  Bededag (Great Prayer
# Day, abolished as a public holiday from 2024) is left out.  Psalm and other
# verse numbers are the Danish Bible's (the heading counted in the Psalms).
# ------------------------------------------- Evangelical Lutheran Church of Finland (variant finland)
# Kirkkokäsikirja (2000) texts: a psalm, a first reading (Old Testament), a
# second reading (Epistle) and a Gospel in three series (vuosikerta, cycle
# I-III; the second is read from Advent 2025).  Where a day has one set it is
# read every year.  Source: Kirkkovuosikalenteri, kirkkovuosikalenteri.fi
# (Kirkkohallitus), read October 2026.  The 6th Sunday after the Epiphany and
# the 26th after Pentecost share their texts.  Psalm and other verse numbers
# are the Finnish Bible's (the heading counted in the Psalms).
